Add no fourth person, second animal, cart, wheel, rigid cargo frame, harness shaft, tree, branch, fence, post, mast, pole, rod, tool handle, fourth staff, text or other elongated object beyond the required three foreground staffs. At full size both corrected hands must exist, remain empty and have background separation from mule tack, with both garment straps ending at the waist. At 140×196 require only exactly three people, one mule and three foreground staff identities countable with no fourth rod-like line; do not enlarge hands, fingers or straps merely to expose those full-size details at mobile size.
reason: Attempt-002 preserved the Three of Wands scene and counts but still drew one independent line from the viewer-right walker’s outer hand toward the lower-right ground and another lead-like connection near the mule. Attempt-003 uses that exact rejected output as its sole source, permits honest whole-canvas resampling, preserves every passing invariant and targets both hand-adjacent lines and endpoints so the corrected walker is visibly empty-handed with a background gap from the mule.
